Skyweave correction 0.3.0 for official Photon 1.4.
Native Colorwheel support is retained; no obsolete 1.3a patcher is applied.
DH shadows use Photon sun-space quartic distortion and native water/color transmission.
Finite shadow-map coverage qualifies directional volumetric sunlight. Out-of-map samples
contribute no unqualified directional sun; ambient scattering is unchanged.

and performance qualification is required; Photon remains unsupported on the Apple fixture.
